title: OpenLogi
author: amatheus
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: HID++BoltUnifyingBluetoothUSBYour Logitech mouse,finally local.A local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust.Remap buttons, drive DPI and SmartShift over HID++.No account, no telemetry.Download$brew install --cask openlogiMIT / Apache-2.0Not affiliated with LogitechClick a button, bind an action.The center of the app, working right here: a mouse diagram with clickable hotspots and a per-button action picker. Choose a hotspot, then bind any of the built-in actions.config.tomlschema_version = 4~/.config/openlogi/config.tomlliveschema_version = 4selected_device = "receiver:aabbccdd:slot:1"[devices."receiver:aabbccdd:slot:1".bindings]MiddleClick = "MissionControl"DpiToggle = "CycleDpiPresets"Thumbwheel = "VolumeUp"Forward = "BrowserForward"Back = "BrowserBack"GestureButton = "AppExpose"MX Master 4Writes straight to config.toml, the file you own.Everything Options+ does, without the account.OpenLogi drives your mouse over HID++ directly: buttons, DPI and SmartShift, from a native app that never phones home.HID++ 2.044 actionsRemap any buttonBind any of 44 built-in actions to each physical button, per device. Custom shortcuts, app launchers and scripted actions too.DPI control & presetsSet pointer resolution and cycle your own presets, written straight to the sensor over HID++.HID++ 0x2201SmartShiftFlip the wheel between ratchet and free-spin, or let it switch automatically by scroll speed.HID++ 0x2111Per-app profilesComing soonPer-application overlays that switch the moment your focused app does. Ships in a later release.Bolt, Unifying, Lightspeed, Bluetooth or wiredReach devices over a Logi Bolt, Unifying or Lightspeed receiver, a direct Bluetooth pairing, or a USB cable. No receiver required.Live device viewA carousel of paired devices with battery percentage and charge state for everything online.HID++ 0x1004Nothing between your mouse and your machine.No account, no telemetry, no cloud. Bindings live in a plain TOML file you own, and every change goes straight to the device over HID++.NetworkDevice renders onlyUp and running in a minute.Signed builds for macOS, Linux and Windows. Pick your platform below. Step-by-step setup lives in the docs..dmg.deb.rpm.msimacOS$brew install --cask openlogiDownload .dmgHomebrew is recommended, or grab the signed .dmg for Apple silicon or Intel.LinuxDownload .debPackages for amd64 and arm64, with .rpm and Arch .pkg.tar.zst builds also available.WindowsNewDownload .msiThe newest port: signed x86_64 and arm64 installers, validated on Windows 11.Quit Logi Options+ before launching: the two fight over HID++ access, and only one app can own a receiver at a time. On Linux, the same applies to Solaar.Will OpenLogi support Logitech Flow?It's on the roadmap, at the far end: a cross-computer pointer and clipboard bridge is a very large feature. The half that lives in the protocol already ships. OpenLogi drives Easy-Switch host switching over HID++ (0x1814/0x1815), and paired mice follow the keyboard when it switches hosts. If the rest lands, it will be opt-in and local-network only.Can I pair a new device from OpenLogi?Bolt pairing ships in the GUI, and Unifying and Lightspeed pairing is in progress. Until it lands, pair once with Logitech's tool or Solaar; OpenLogi drives the device from then on.Can I import my Options+ settings?Not yet, though an importer is in progress. In the meantime, bindings are a short TOML file you can rebuild in minutes, and unlike Options+ they stay in one portable, hand-editable file.Why does macOS ask for Accessibility permission?OpenLogi remaps the side buttons (Back, Forward, middle click) through a CGEventTap, and macOS puts event taps behind the Accessibility permission. The HID++ paths (gesture button, thumb wheel, DPI, SmartShift) don't need it.How do updates work?Only when you ask. The in-app update check is opt-in and off by default; new builds come from Homebrew (brew upgrade --cask openlogi) or the signed installers on the releases page.Do my bindings move to another machine?Copy the TOML file. Devices are keyed by physical identity (receiver serial and slot, or the device's own serial), so the same mouse keeps its bindings wherever the file goes. Built-in sync may come one day, but it's hard to square with the no-account principle.

comments.author: xlii
comments.textRawHtml:
2 anecdotes about Logitech software:

I had a high-end webcam that flickered. There should be switch in the software to switch from 50hz to 60hz that'd fix it but it was nowhere to be found. After digging deeper I found that it was only available in English version of software. It was before macOS had Setting to set language per app, so I had to manually replace Polish bundle with English one through binary.

Another one: Has K810 keyboard that started in "FN-by-default" mode. K811, Mac version of said keyboard allowed for changing default setting just as K810 on Windows, but K810 on Mac - no dice. Support told me to shell out 200€ on Mac keyboard so I ended up writing small binary switcher [0] that would run after keyboard got connected [0].

[0]: https://github.com/exlee/k810_fkeys_mac
comments.textZhHtml:
关于罗技软件的 2 个轶事：

我有一个闪烁的高端网络摄像头。软件中应该有从 50hz 切换到 60hz 的开关来解决这个问题，但无处可寻。经过深入研究，我发现它仅适用于英文版软件。当时 macOS 还没有为每个应用程序设置语言的设置，所以我必须通过二进制手动将波兰语捆绑包替换为英语捆绑包。

另一个：具有以“默认 FN”模式启动的 K810 键盘。 K811，Mac 版本的键盘允许更改默认设置，就像 Windows 上的 K810 一样，但 Mac 上的 K810 - 没有骰子。支持人员告诉我在 Mac 键盘上花 200 欧元，所以我最终编写了一个小型二进制切换器 [0]，它将在键盘连接后运行 [0]。

[0]: https://github.com/exlee/k810_fkeys_mac

children.author: vanderZwan
children.textRawHtml:
> I had a high-end webcam that flickered. There should be switch in the software to switch from 50hz to 60hz that'd fix it but it was nowhere to be found.

Similar issue, although I'm not sure if it's the Logitech webcam or just how webcams are automatically configured on Linux these days in general: if I use a really bright LED lamp, the automatic exposure time goes down to the point that it doesn't matter if the webcam is set to 50hz or 60hz, it's going to catch flickering from other subtle frequencies affecting light output. I've also had situations where I wanted to use it to film a white piece of paper that I'm writing on, but it automatically adjusts exposure to make it gray instead.

It took me forever to find something with a straightforward GUI that lets me manually override this behavior on Linux. I ended up settling for cameractrls.

https://github.com/soyersoyer/cameractrls
children.textZhHtml:
> 我有一个闪烁的高端网络摄像头。软件中应该有一个从 50hz 切换到 60hz 的开关可以解决这个问题，但无处可寻。

类似的问题，尽管我不确定这是否是 Logitech 网络摄像头的问题，或者目前 Linux 上网络摄像头是如何自动配置的：如果我使用非常亮的 LED 灯，自动曝光时间会缩短到网络摄像头是否设置为 50hz 或60hz，它将捕获影响光输出的其他微妙频率的闪烁。我也遇到过这样的情况：我想用它来拍摄一张我正在写字的白纸，但它会自动调整曝光使其变成灰色。

我花了很长时间才找到一个具有简单 GUI 的东西，可以让我在 Linux 上手动覆盖此行为。我最终选择了cameractrls。

https://github.com/soyersoyer/cameractrls

children.author: wowczarek
children.textRawHtml:
One anecdote about a piece of Logitech hardware:

My once top of the range Brio USB 3.0 webcam produces so much high frequency EMI that GNSS receivers in its vicinity completely fail to operate across all bands (1.1 - 1.6 GHz). I had to disconnect it and use it from elsewhere, otherwise my lab dies. I have tens of others USB 3.0 devices that don't do this.
children.textZhHtml:
关于罗技硬件的一则轶事：

我的曾经顶级的 Brio USB 3.0 网络摄像头会产生如此多的高频 EMI，以至于其附近的 GNSS 接收器完全无法在所有频段 (1.1 - 1.6 GHz) 上运行。我必须断开它并从其他地方使用它，否则我的实验室就会崩溃。我还有数十个其他 USB 3.0 设备无法执行此操作。

children.author: bugsmith
children.textRawHtml:
Honestly, I'm always blown away by accounts if "so I just wrote a binary switcher" dropped casually like this. I'm a software engineer and have been for over five years, but wouldn't even know where to _begin_ with something like that. Well, I would, I'd end up vibecoding a slop solution I didn't really understand.

How did you know / learn how to write a binary switcher?
children.textZhHtml:
老实说，如果“所以我只是写了一个二进制切换器”像这样随意掉落，我总是会被帐户所震惊。我是一名软件工程师，已经工作五年多了，但我什至不知道从哪里开始做这样的事情。好吧，我会，我最终会编码一个我不太理解的草率解决方案。

您是如何知道/学习如何编写二进制切换器的？

children.author: xlii
children.textRawHtml:
I know that's a skill that I have, and I used it so many times it became effortless, but it all goes to one of jokes I like - that asks how do you eat an elephant. Easy - with a fork.

So in that particular case I have a keyboard and it's misbehaving. I know that by some dark magic I can make it behave as I want and that software on Windows can do that.

So I think, "ok, how does it communicate?" - with Bluetooth, obviously. So my next thought it: can I transmit over bluetooth magic bytes that do exactly like this. I definitely have a device on my computer, so I can try to make it.

From that it's all about "how to send arbitrary stuff from bluetooth" search. Instinct tells me there has to be a library, or that at least on person on world wide web tried to do something similar.

If I find even single instance of this, I'm home - read what they did, try to figure out if I can adjust it and do so. Hocus pocus - binary switcher happens.

Though, in the end, it's all about approach. I found many people say "I don't know how to do it, so I don't". My approach is "I rarely know what do, but that doesn't stop me from trying". And this trying new stuff brings practice for the next unknown endeavor.
children.textZhHtml:
我知道这是我拥有的一项技能，而且我使用了很多次，它变得毫不费力，但这一切都源于我喜欢的一个笑话 - 那问你如何吃掉大象。简单 - 用叉子。

所以在这种特殊情况下，我有一个键盘，但它表现不佳。我知道通过某种黑魔法我可以让它按照我想要的方式运行，Windows 上的软件也可以做到这一点。

所以我想，“好吧，它是如何通信的？” - 显然是通过蓝牙。所以我的下一个想法是：我可以通过蓝牙魔法字节进行传输吗？我的计算机上肯定有一个设备，所以我可以尝试制作它。

从这一切都是关于“如何从蓝牙发送任意内容”搜索。直觉告诉我必须有一个图书馆，或者至少在万维网上有人试图做类似的事情。

如果我发现哪怕是一个这样的例子，我就回家了 - 阅读他们做了什么，尝试弄清楚我是否可以调整它并这样做。 Hocus pocus - 二进制切换器发生了。

不过，最终，这都是关于方法的。我发现很多人说“我不知道该怎么做，所以我不做”。我的方法是“我很少知道该做什么，但这并不妨碍我尝试”。这种尝试新事物为下一个未知的尝试带来了练习。

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml: It is because you're unlikely a software engineer and just a learn programming or went through a really bad university.
children.textZhHtml: 这是因为你不太可能成为一名软件工程师，而只是学习编程，或者上过一所非常糟糕的大学。

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml: I have. Can you help me understand what is the issue with my comment? Can we not agree that not being able to know where to even start with studying and changing a binary is foundational to being a software engineer?
children.textZhHtml: 我有。您能帮我理解我的评论有什么问题吗？我们是否可以同意，不知道从哪里开始研究和更改二进制文件是成为软件工程师的基础？

children.author: gatio
children.textRawHtml:
As a native english speaker, your comment came across as an unnecessary slight. It might not have been the intent.

Not everyone has had the same experiences, interests, or life/work opportunities in the same way, and this person seems genuinely interested in learning more. It's something to be encouraged.
children.textZhHtml:
作为一名以英语为母语的人，您的评论给人一种不必要的轻视。这可能不是意图。

并非每个人都以相同的方式拥有相同的经历、兴趣或生活/工作机会，并且此人似乎真正有兴趣了解更多信息。这是值得鼓励的事情。

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml:
I don't think pandering to the ideas that basically amount to "a 6 week bootcamp makes you a Software Engineer" is honest or useful. It is sycophancy and disingenuous. If someone doesn't even know where to start looking for replacing a binary in a package; they have no grounds to call themselves a "Software Engineer".

Consider how would you respond if someone made a remark like this:

> Honestly, I'm always blown away by accounts [of] "so I just welded the pipes" dropped casually like this. I'm a plumber and have been for over five years, but wouldn't even know where to _begin_ with something like that.
children.textZhHtml:
我认为迎合基本上相当于“6 周训练营让你成为软件工程师”的想法是诚实或有用的。这是阿谀奉承和虚伪的。如果有人甚至不知道从哪里开始寻找替换包中的二进制文件；他们没有理由称自己为“软件工程师”。

考虑一下，如果有人发表这样的言论，你会如何回应：

> 老实说，我总是被这样随意丢弃的“所以我只是焊接管道”的说法所震撼。我是一名水管工，已经工作五年多了，但我什至不知道从哪里开始做这样的事情。

children.author: gatio
children.textRawHtml:
I'd raise an eyebrow, because plumbers here are a trade with on the job training, and pipework is an essential part of it.

Software has a huge surface area these days. That a trained software engineer isn't aware that HIDs and input subsystems are often highly hackable from userspace is no surprise to me.

They may also have been leaning into a compliment of OP in a self deprecating way.

shrug
children.textZhHtml:
我会感到惊讶，因为这里的管道工是在职培训的行业，而管道工程是其中的重要组成部分。

如今，软件拥有巨大的表面积。 训练有素的软件工程师不知道 HID 和输入子系统通常很容易从用户空间被黑客攻击，这对我来说并不奇怪。

他们也可能倾向于以一种自嘲的方式赞美 OP。

耸耸肩

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml:
The problem isn't that you should know everything, but that you should know how to dig into these things. The op isn't even talking about HID and input subsystem, they're talking about replacing a goddamn binary in a package. It is a tiny step above working a Zip archive.

C'mon. Don't shrug me now after going all proverbial pointy finger at me for expecting an "Engineer" to know the basics.
children.textZhHtml:
问题不在于你应该知道一切，而在于你应该知道如何深入研究这些东西。该操作甚至没有谈论 HID 和输入子系统，他们谈论的是替换包中的该死的二进制文件。这比处理 Zip 存档只迈出了一小步。

来吧。在对我指望“工程师”了解基础知识之后，现在不要耸耸肩。

children.author: gatio
children.textRawHtml: OC provided a link to the git repo for his "binary switcher", which you should investigate..
children.textZhHtml: OC 提供了一个指向他的“二进制切换器”的 git 存储库的链接，您应该调查一下。

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml: It is of little interest to me since Solaar does all I need, but should I need to, I will dig right into. Nothing to sweat about.
children.textZhHtml: 我对此没什么兴趣，因为 Solaar 满足了我需要的一切，但如果我需要的话，我会直接深入研究。没什么可担心的。

children.author: spl757
children.textRawHtml:
This part: "Be kind. Don't be snarky. Converse curiously; don't cross-examine. Edit out swipes.

Comments should get more thoughtful and substantive, not less, as a topic gets more divisive."
children.textZhHtml:
这部分： “要友善。不要刻薄。好奇地交谈；不要盘问。编辑掉滑动。

随着主题变得更加分裂，评论应该变得更加深思熟虑和实质性，而不是更少。”

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml: Saying that "a software engineer requires a baseline of understanding of software engineering" is substantive and anything short of that is not "thoughtful" or "kind" but rather disingenuous and sycophantic. Pretend nice is poison feed with delicious juice in fine china, looks good, might be delicious, but still hurts you in the long run.
children.textZhHtml: 说“软件工程师需要对软件工程有基本的理解”是实质性的，任何缺乏这一点的东西都不是“深思熟虑的”或“友善的”，而是不诚实和阿谀奉承的。假装美好是在精美的瓷器中注入美味果汁的毒饲料，看起来不错，可能很美味，但从长远来看仍然会伤害你。

children.author: spl757
children.textRawHtml:
My comment might have been different if you had said "a software engineer requires a baseline of understanding of software engineering", but that is not what you said.

What you said is "It is because you're unlikely a software engineer and just a learn programming or went through a really bad university.".

Saying he is unlikely a software engineer seems to imply OP is not being truthful, or is outright lying.

I'll take you at your word that it was not your intention to be offensive. If I were communicating in a language that is not my native tongue, I would hope that someone would point out to me that I might be being misunderstood, too.

As far as the wording of the rules, you would have to complain to HN about that if you take issue with it.
children.textZhHtml:
如果您说“软件工程师需要对软件工程有一定的了解”，我的评论可能会有所不同，但这不是您所说的。

您所说的是“这是因为您不太可能成为软件工程师，只是学习编程或上过一所非常糟糕的大学。”。

说他不太可能是软件工程师似乎暗示 OP 不诚实，或者完全是在撒谎。

我会请相信你的话，你无意冒犯。如果我用非母语的语言进行交流，我希望有人向我指出我也可能被误解。

就规则的措辞而言，如果您对此有异议，则必须向 HN 投诉。

children.author: asdfsa32
children.textRawHtml:
Op is making a claim about being a software engineer without having the necessary baseline of skills discussed. I have proposed two possible reasons, self-thought programmer who didn't get to the bottom of things, or just went through a really poor university.

You're making a whole lot of assumptions there without being " thoughtful and substantive". So I invite you to a bit of self-reflection and let this conversation be.
children.textZhHtml:
Op 声称自己是一名软件工程师，但没有讨论必要的技能基线。我提出了两个可能的原因，自认为程序员没有追根究底，或者只是上了一所非常糟糕的大学。

你在那里做了很多假设，而没有“深思熟虑和实质性”。因此，我邀请您进行一些自我反思，并让这次谈话就这样进行。
